node.title: M31 top-neighbor core-shadow payment
node.statement: For the M31 dense top-neighbor terminal, every fixed degree-(4980-r) divisor core supports at most floor(C(1053557-4981+r+1,r+1)/C(67447+r+1,r+1))-1 actual top neighbors. In particular a degree-4979 one-root-swap core supports at most 240 neighbors. Therefore an anchor with 215793 top neighbors realizes at least 4477705 distinct degree-4979 cores.
node.notes: Exact actual-list fixed-core payment and shadow floor only. It does not aggregate across cores, prove the local excluding cap, pay Q=147595, or move a Prize endpoint.
